methodology: The 20 remaining accessories with exactly one official radius-4 cylinder are rechecked against the closed reference-figure meshes after the conservative bounding-box pass rejected them. A part passes only when at least one deterministic axial contact and orientation has zero points inside the closed body meshes. Physical clutch force is not asserted.
